title: 4K EQ
summary: British console EQ for the master bus. Four calibrated bands, stepped filters, Brown and Black voicings.

pages.title: Main
lines: LF LMF HMF HF are the four band
HPF and LPF are the stepped

pages.title: Bands
lines: Each band's frequency, plus Q for
LF Bl / HF Bl switch those bands

pages.title: Setup
lines: OS: 2x is the default. 1x saves a
little CPU and is clean in Brown.
